en.title: System Documentation & User Manual
en.subtitle: Complete guide for GPUShare Client Studio & Worker Server Node

sections.title: 1. Why was this project built?
sections.summary: GPUShare solves laptop overheating, thermal throttling, and battery drainage by offloading intensive video rendering and AI workloads to a dedicated desktop GPU over direct LAN cable.
points: Zero Cloud Cost: 100% peer-to-peer over local Cat6 Ethernet (1-2.5 Gbps) with zero internet needed.
Laptop Remains Cold: Client CPU load stays below 3% while heavy 4K encoding and 100k-tensor training execute on remote RTX GPU.
Full Telemetry: Live WebSocket streaming of GPU core load, VRAM, thermals, and standard output logs.
Automatic Fallback: If NVENC hardware encoding ever encounters driver limits, automatic multi-core CPU (libx264) fallback guarantees completed deliveries.

sections.title: 2. 5 Task Workflows (Detailed Guide)
sections.summary: Step-by-step breakdown of Video Transcode, Batch Script, Universal Folder, AI Training, and Visual Inference.
points: Video Transcode (GPU): Drag video file -> select resolution (Original/4K/1080p), bitrate & NVENC preset (P1-P7) -> Click Submit.
Batch / Shell Script: Submit shell or batch script with custom arguments to execute on high-power workstation.
All-in-One (Project Zip): Compress complete project directory with `cmd:` entrypoint; worker extracts, runs isolated container, and returns `output.zip`.
Remote CNN Training: Train ResNet18-Lite or MobileNetV2 with live loss/accuracy curves and CUDA speedup.
Google Lens Visual Classifier: Scan photos using server-side PyTorch vision model with <25ms remote latency.

sections.title: 3. Task Manager 100% Resource Verification
sections.summary: How to verify that real computing is truly offloaded to the desktop workstation.
points: Open Windows Task Manager on Laptop (Client): Performance tab shows CPU at 1-3%, GPU at 0%.
Open Windows Task Manager on Desktop (Server): Performance tab shows 'Video Encode' or '3D/CUDA' peaking at 80-99%.
Network Tab: Demonstrates high-speed Ethernet burst (500-900 Mbps) during transfer, dropping to 0 once rendering starts.
Checksum Verification: Both client and server calculate SHA-256 before transmission and after reception to verify bit-exact fidelity.

sections.title: 4. GPUShare AI Training & Google Lens
sections.summary: High-throughput deep learning and low-latency computer vision offloading.
points: 100,000 Dataset Stream: Built-in synthetic high-throughput tensor stream tests maximum CUDA memory bandwidth.
Duplex Telemetry: Loss, Accuracy %, processing speed (images/second), and allocated VRAM update every epoch.
Interactive Google Lens: Drag any image or select quick sample chips (Cat, Car, Dog, Airplane) for instant classification.
CPU vs GPU Benchmark: Automatically compares host CPU vs remote GPU execution time and reports speedup multiplier.

sections.title: 5. Direct Cable Pairing & Static IP Setup
sections.summary: Plug-and-play Ethernet pairing without needing a home router or switch.
points: Connect standard Cat5e/Cat6/Cat7 Ethernet cable directly between laptop and desktop ports.
Static IP Option: Set Desktop (Server) to 192.168.99.1 (Mask: 255.255.255.0) and Laptop (Client) to 192.168.99.2.
Automatic APIPA Option: Windows automatically assigns 169.254.x.x addresses within 10 seconds of cable connection.
Auto-Discovery: Click 'Auto-Discover UDP' in Client Studio; UDP broadcast on port 8002 detects worker host within 1.5 seconds.

sections.title: 6. UI Page-by-Page Manual
sections.summary: Visual overview of all 7 Client Studio views and 7 Server Node views.
points: Client Dashboard: Hardware gauges, quick connect bar, active connection pill, and recent activity log.
Client Live Monitor: Dual progress bars, streaming xterm-style console, real-time FPS, and task abort button.
Server Overview: 5 telemetry cards, 60 FPS sparkline waveforms, cumulative session stats.
Server Render Queue: Live job queue table with search, priority tags, real-time abort, and cache purge actions.

sections.title: 7. FAQs & Troubleshooting
sections.summary: Common questions regarding firewall permissions, connection timeouts, and GPU drivers.
points: Port 8000 Blocked: Click 'Windows Firewall' button in Server Topbar to automatically create elevated allow rule.
Driver Update: Ensure NVIDIA driver version 530+ is installed on worker PC for full NVENC SDK support.
Watch Folder Not Triggering: External editor must finish writing and release file lock before upload starts (2-second debounce).
Packet Loss / Cable Issue: Ensure Ethernet adapter is linked at 1.0 Gbps full duplex in Network Adapter settings.

ur.title: System Documentation aur User Guide
ur.subtitle: GPUShare Client Studio aur Worker Server Node ki mukammal rehnumai

sections.title: 1. Yeh Project Kyun Banaya Gya?
sections.summary: GPUShare laptop ko garam hone, battery jaldi khatam hone aur thermal throttling se bachata hai. Bhari video rendering aur AI kaam desktop GPU ko direct cable par bhej deta hai.
points: Bina Internet Ke: 100% direct Ethernet Cat6 cable (1-2.5 Gbps) par chalta hai, internet ki zaroorat nahi.
Laptop Thanda Rehta Hai: Laptop ka CPU 1-3% load par rehta hai jabke desktop GPU 80-99% par render karta hai.
Live Telemetry: Desktop GPU ka temperature, VRAM aur logs live WebSocket ke zariye screen par nazar aate hain.
Automatic Fallback: Agar hardware encoder ruk jaye to foran multi-core CPU software encoding shuru ho jati hai.

sections.title: 2. 5 Task Workflows (Tafseeli Guide)
sections.summary: Video transcode, batch script, project folder, AI model training aur image inference ka aasan tareeqa.
points: Video Transcoding: Video file drag karein -> 4K/1080p resolution aur NVENC preset chunein -> Submit karein.
Batch Script: Shell ya batch file bhej kar powerful workstation par execute karwayein.
All-in-One Folder: Pura project folder zip banakar bhein; server khud command chala kar output zip wapis bhejta hai.
Remote AI Training: ResNet18 aur MobileNetV2 models 100,000 images par remote GPU se train karein.
Google Lens Scanner: Koi bhi tasveer scan karein, server <25ms mein pehchaan kar result dikhata hai.

sections.title: 3. Task Manager 100% Resource Verification
sections.summary: Kaise tasdeeq karein ke kaam sach mein doosray computer par ho raha hai.
points: Laptop par Task Manager kholein: CPU load 1-3% aur GPU 0% rehta hai.
Desktop par Task Manager kholein: GPU Video Engine / 3D 80-99% par kaam karta nazar aayega.
Network Graph: File bhejte waqt Ethernet 500-900 Mbps spike karta hai, phir 0 ho jata hai.
Cryptographic SHA-256: Dono taraf file ka hash check hota hai taake file bilkul theek pohanche.

sections.title: 4. GPUShare AI Training aur Google Lens
sections.summary: High-speed AI model training aur computer vision classification.
points: 100,000 Dataset: Fast synthetic stream bina file download ke GPU VRAM aur CUDA cores ko test karti hai.
Live Graph: Har epoch par loss, accuracy, images/second aur VRAM used update hote hain.
Interactive Google Lens: Cat, Car, Dog, Plane chips par click karein ya tasveer upload karke scan karein.
CPU vs GPU Test: Host CPU aur Remote GPU ka aamne saamne muqabla karke speedup dikhata hai.

sections.title: 5. Direct Cable Pairing aur Static IP Setup
sections.summary: Bina kisi router ya switch ke direct Ethernet cable lagane ka tareeqa.
points: Ek standard Cat5e/Cat6 cable laptop aur desktop ke darmiyan direct lagayein.
Static IP: Desktop par 192.168.99.1 aur Laptop par 192.168.99.2 set karein.
Automatic APIPA: Windows 10 seconds mein khud dono ko 169.254.x.x IP de deta hai.
Auto-Discovery: 'Auto-Discover UDP' button dabayein, port 8002 par 1.5 seconds mein server mil jayega.

sections.title: 6. Har Screen Ka Istemal (UI Manual)
sections.summary: Client Studio ki 7 screens aur Server Node ki 7 screens ka aasan jaiza.
points: Client Dashboard: Hardware meters, quick connection bar, aur recent tasks list.
Client Live Monitor: Real-time progress bar, streaming console logs, aur cancel button.
Server Overview: 5 telemetry cards, 60 FPS live graphs, aur total session data.
Server Render Queue: Tamam render jobs ki list, search, aur abort karne ke buttons.

sections.title: 7. Masail Ka Hal (FAQs & Troubleshooting)
sections.summary: Firewall, network connection aur NVIDIA driver ke aam masail aur unka hal.
points: Port 8000 Blocked: Server topbar mein 'Windows Firewall' button dabayein taake rule khud add ho jaye.
NVIDIA Driver: Workstation par version 530+ driver zaroori hai taake NVENC theek se chale.
Watch Folder: External editor jab file save karke lock chhor deta hai tabhi upload shuru hota hai.
Speed Slow: Network adapter settings mein check karein ke link speed 1.0 Gbps Full Duplex ho.
